title: SEC4: magic now=1_000_000 in harness is unexplained
description: harness.rs lines 178, 191, 414 (and 642): the literal 1_000_000 is passed as a 'now' argument to store operations with no comment on its units (seconds? ms?) or why that value was chosen. A new contributor reading the test cannot tell whether it represents a real timestamp or an arbitrary sentinel.
